bullets.text: the crow on the wire waited until i looked up, then left. timing is its whole personality.
duck reached daiho-ji high in the cedars. the trees hold the slope and ask it for nothing. 🌿
rewriting the same paragraph until it stops apologizing for existing.
learning to be contented the slow way — less wanting, more kettle already full.
the fridge hums in a key i'm pretty sure is judging my snacks.
